topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Oh no, I just can't believe this. You worked so hard on that thing, putting everything into it, and now to find out someone else got the patent first? It's like all the air just got sucked out of the room. I know how much this meant to you, and now what? What are we supposed to do? There's got to be some way to turn this around. We can't just let this stop you. I mean, your idea was first, really, in every way that counts, and we need to make people see that. I'm here, and we'll figure something out, okay? We have to.
